label: central memory CD4-positive, alpha-beta preT follicular helper cell
evidence: ASTA has only the atlas abstract (King et al. 2021, CorpusId 238530091), so the fine Azimuth label was resolved against the broader Tfh-differentiation literature rather than the atlas full text. The label maps to the well-described precursor Tfh (pre-Tfh) stage: a CXCR5-intermediate, CCR7-positive CD4+ alpha-beta cell primed at the T:B border and committing toward the germinal-center Tfh program while retaining a central-memory-like state (Schroeder et al., 2021; Shen & Fu, 2025; Zhu et al., 2023).
